title: On the Hamiltonicity, traceability and toughness of complements of line graphs
summary: A coline graph $\text{co}(G)$ of a graph $G$ is the graph with vertex set $E(G)$ for which two vertices $e$ and $e'$ of $\text{co}(G)$ are adjacent if and only if they are not adjacent as edges in $G$. A graph $G$ is tough if the number of connected components of $G-S$ is at most $|S|$ for all cut sets $S$. Wu and Meng, and Liu independently gave similar characterisations of coline graphs that are Hamiltonian.
